title: Blackbox: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common Blackbox failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If a lead feels blocked, inspect the item, check related Wiki entries, and confirm required optional modules are loaded before assuming the route is broken.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If the route becomes confusing, stop consuming clues. Sort fragments by name, revisit the last record, and choose the smallest action that can confirm meaning.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
